newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 7.19 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's UDI bonds real return 7.19 pct.

text.p: Mexico's UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 100.83581 UDIs and a real return of 7.19 percent at the primary auction on Tuesday.
Two weeks ago the UDI bonds were assigned at a price of 100.65554 UDIs and a real return of 7.73 percent.
Demand this week was 1.49 billion UDIs compared to 250 million UDIs on offer from Banco de Mexico with a bid-to-cover ratio of 5.96.
Two weeks ago demand was 1.2 billion UDIs with a bid-to-cover ratio of 6.0.
